characters.name: Daia
characters.voice_notes: 'Aunt Daia', co-parent in Gladias and Seila's co-family (mother of Febric and Hreda, married to Vil). Friendly, chatty, attentive to the children.

characters.name: Gladias
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Veridia chapters; newly made Keeper in the Order. Thoughtful, earnest, slightly awkward, argues carefully. Inside Keeper booths he is addressed by a number (Four, Six or Two depending on the circle).

characters.name: Vil
characters.voice_notes: 'Uncle Vil', co-parent in the co-family (father of Febric and Hreda). Considerate, a bit weary; explains his lawsuit against Divergent in detail.

characters.name: Seila
characters.voice_notes: Gladias's wife, mother, economics-and-culture blogger. Warm, playful, quick; fond of Dzego; protective of the children.

characters.name: Helisport instructor
characters.voice_notes: School Helisport instructor and referee; loud, upbeat sports-announcer delivery, shouting scores across a field.

characters.name: Helisport children
characters.voice_notes: About ten schoolchildren shouting one word in unison; excited. The line sits inside a narrator run.

characters.name: Keeper T (air quality circle)
characters.voice_notes: Unnamed Keeper in the air-quality circle who knows the rubric details and pushes for higher taxes; worried about Arctic bio-attacks; earnest, a little impatient. Number not given (starts with T). Keepers speak through neck bands with re-randomized AI-generated voices, so the voice need not reveal gender.

characters.name: Keeper O (air quality circle)
characters.voice_notes: Unnamed Keeper in the air-quality circle; skeptic of intervention, trusts markets and technology, sarcastic, privacy-minded. Number not given (starts with O). Keepers speak through neck bands with re-randomized AI-generated voices, so the voice need not reveal gender.

characters.name: Keeper E (air quality circle)
characters.voice_notes: Unnamed Keeper in the air-quality circle who interjects with gossip about the quadratic-funding scandal; knowing, cynical. Number not given (starts with E). Keepers speak through neck bands with re-randomized AI-generated voices, so the voice need not reveal gender.

notes: D is Daia throughout (Delwart and Den do not speak in this chapter). The Keeper scene 11:95-11:123 is a third circle (air quality, Gladias is 'Two'); its T, O and E speakers are never numbered, and since numbers are assigned per circle I treat them as new people rather than Twenty/Thirteen, One or Eleven/Eighteen from chapter 10. 11:30 is a narrator run containing the children's shouted reply in quotation marks followed by a narration tag; listed in narrator_exceptions, split at the quotation marks. 11:127 is the written text of a Hydrafill advertisement (narrator quote runs), not speech.
